title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 9: Keiko Nagamatsu
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．９ ～永松恵子～
overview:
Appearing on TV, in magazines, and in commercials one after another! Everything about private idol Keiko Nagamatsu, all in one disc!!

Volume 9 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Keiko Nagamatsu, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, learn more about her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

TV、雑誌、CMに続々出演!プライベートアイドル永松恵子のすべてを収録!!
